ядра.подтема: что делает thinking у image-моделей Gemini 3
ядра.ядро_en: Gemini 3 image models are thinking models that use a reasoning process ("Thinking") for complex prompts.

модели_различия.текст_en: Same as the core; "designed to tackle the most challenging image generation by incorporating state-of-the-art reasoning capabilities" (E-42-3); "What sets Nano Banana Pro apart is its ability to "think" before it creates" (E-69-2, blog); in the cookbook: "flagship model with advanced reasoning (thinking)" (E-20-4, E-326-3).
Same as the core; "evaluate prompt instructions and plan visual composition before generating the image" (E-20-44, E-326-36).
Included in "Gemini 3 image models" (E-1-81, E-1-43); the input has no separate words about what thinking gives Lite specifically.
Thinking: Not supported (see the rule on thinking support by model).

Family page: "Generate images that follow real-world logic, thanks to Gemini's advanced reasoning capabilities" (E-136-8); general mechanism: thinking strengthens reasoning and multi-step planning (E-8-1, E-46-1), with the benefits listed on text tasks.

оговорки.текст_en: Nano-Banana Pro (gemini-3-pro-image-preview) and Nano-Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image) include reasoning capabilities ("thinking") to evaluate prompt instructions and plan visual composition before generating the image.
Built on the Gemini 3 family of models, Nano Banana models apply deep reasoning capabilities to fully understand your prompt before generating an image.
It uses reasoning to "think" through a prompt and can retrieve real-time data—such as weather forecasts or stock charts—before using Google Search grounding before generating high-fidelity images.

Nano Banana Pro is framed as part of a reasoning-plus-multimodal-output stack; thinking before creating and Search grounding with real-time data are presented together as the reason it suits slide/infographic generation with current data.

Thinking models are trained to generate an internal "thinking process" before producing a response. As a result, thinking models are capable of stronger reasoning, multi-step planning, mathematical problem-solving, and code generation than models without thinking capabilities.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The task has a complex prompt: many linked conditions, spatial logic, data or an infographic, or an open "come up with it yourself" request; the author decides how much to spell out and whether the model can be trusted to plan the composition.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The Nano Banana (2.5 Flash Image) model, where thinking is not supported; questions of levels, billing and thought signatures are separate rules; the Gemini app, where "Thinking" is a menu item.
ядра.магнит_причина: a caveat carries data examples from Google's text (weather forecasts, stock charts)

словарь_терминов.значение_en: The model's reasoning mode before it answers; for Gemini 3 image models, evaluating the prompt instructions and planning the composition before generation. Variants across pages: on model cards it is a capability row "Thinking"; in the blog, "think before it creates" (E-69-2); in the Gemini app "Thinking" is a menu item/model (E-237-13, E-276-29).

The discrete thinking level of Gemini 3 and newer; values minimal, low, medium, high; support depends on the model. Variants across pages: "one of two states" and "low or high" (page 133) versus four values; for image models: minimal/high (NB2, Lite), HIGH only (Pro); the NB2 blog says "High/Dynamic"; page 8 says "maximum" (not a parameter value).

"Little to no thinking"; "as close as possible to a zero budget for thinking but still requires thought signatures"; the default on NB2 and Lite. Variants across pages: page 133: "Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite only", without image models.

More tokens for thinking, for complex prompts with deep reasoning; the only level of Pro Image. Variants across pages: "default level for Gemini 3 models" (page 133) / "for Gemini 3 Pro models and Gemini 3 Flash" (page 46), both about text models.

By default the model itself adjusts the amount of reasoning to the complexity of the request. Variants across pages: the NB2 blog says "High/Dynamic" (E-148-15); whether this is the same value as high is not stated.

The number of thought tokens; the mechanism of Gemini 2.5 and earlier; by default the model decides itself, up to 8,192 tokens. Variants across pages: page 133 calls it "legacy"; using it together with thinking_level in one request is an error (400).

Interim images the model draws during thinking to check composition and logic; visible in the backend, not charged. Variants across pages: "up to two" (Gemini API) versus "maximum of 1 thought image" (Agent Platform preview); page 53 does not define the term.

A summary of the reasoning that the API can return along with the answer; the content is text and/or images. Variants across pages: Interactions: thinking_summaries auto|none; generateContent: include_thoughts=True; in Agent Studio they are on by default.

An encrypted representation of the internal reasoning; it must be returned in later turns to keep the context. Variants across pages: "encrypted representations" / "encrypted tokens" (E-133-38) / "signature hash for backend validation" (E-28-27) / "opaque … base64" (E-125-14).

Where a thought sits in the response: in Interactions, a separate step of type "thought"; in generateContent, the thought flag on a part. Variants across pages: generateContent has no dedicated thought blocks (E-8-5).
Reasoning tokens; they are part of the response price and of the usage counters. Variants across pages: Interactions: total_thought_tokens; generateContent: thoughtsTokenCount.
A mode where the whole history is sent in every request; in it, thought blocks must be returned unchanged.
A finish reason: the request is missing at least one thought signature. Variants across pages: on pages 46/133: "400 error" / "error instead of a warning".

Слияний нет: пары с общими источниками (уровни NB2/Lite и замеры качества/задержки; мысли видны и включение сводок; тарификация и промежуточные картинки; подписи: что это / рекомендация / ручная история) говорят разное — оставлены раздельно со связями.
Каноническая форма: модели → да/нет/частично/не_сказано по тексту части (да 75, нет 11, частично 11, не_сказано 77; легенда — дополнительно.ч1), все 100 текстов по моделям — в модели_различия; ядро_en_из → роль «формулирует»; «версия_противоречия» убрана из ролей; дата_тип → 4 значения; заголовки источников взяты из файлов страниц; примеры — полный текст из извлечения.
Переведено 204 строки (ситуация/не_применяется 58, магнит_причина 15, тексты моделей 100, словарь 31) + значения 102 терминов ядер написаны по-английски по фрагментам источников (в части были только названия). ядро_en, оговорки и приёмы части уже были английскими.
